findings.issue: Spanish makes the earthen vessel the subject of the fall. יִפֹּל is qal imperfect 3ms with no subject pronoun; מֵהֶם is only the plural source, and the 3ms suffix on תּוֹכוֹ marks the vessel as the container into whose midst something falls.
findings.spanishSpan: utensilio de barro que cayere desde ellos a su medio

notes: The rest matches: כל אשר בתוכו as what becomes unclean, qal 3ms, and 2mp תִשְׁבֹּרוּ with אתו as ustedes quebrarán.
